justification: Inspected `gson/src/main/java/com/google/gson/JsonElement.java` (434 LOC, 21 public methods) plus `JsonPrimitive.java`, `JsonObject.java`, `JsonArray.java`, and `JsonElementTypeAdapter.java`. Although the class is API-heavy, its methods are cohesive: type checks, safe casts, primitive accessors, and `toString()` for one JSON-node abstraction. Most methods are thin one-liners or default `UnsupportedOperationException` hooks, while concrete behavior is split across the final subclasses, so there is no clear evidence of the class being insufficiently modularized.
